value.name: Miles insults Marilyn's competence
value.description: Miles tells Marilyn she is out of her league and asserts that he is the professional.
evidence: MILES You're out of your league, Marylin. Rexroth was a primate. I'm a professional.

value.name: Marylin reveals IRS pressure
value.description: Marylin says she is also a professional and warns Miles that IRS Agent Wilson is involved and tenacious.
evidence: MARYLIN I know. So am I, right? And so is Agent Wilson of the Internal Revenue Service. He's a dedicated, underpaid graduate of Southwestern University -- very tenacious, and never more so than when he's dealing with an unscrupulous colleague.

value.name: Marylin threatens legal action
value.description: Marylin stands to leave and warns Miles that she will file an action and later seek an injunction barring him from her house.
evidence: (She stands to leave) I think it's only fair to warn you: I'm going to file an action, Miles. And after a decent interval I plan to have Ruth seek an injunction that will forbid your approach within feet of my house.

value.name: Miles claims house ownership
value.description: Miles objects that Marylin is treating his house as hers, and Marylin replies that the residence will be part of the settlement.
evidence: MARYLIN I believe the residence will be part of the settlement.

value.name: Miles questions their marriage
value.description: Miles asks whether their marriage ever meant anything to Marylin, exposing his hurt and insecurity.
evidence: MILES Did our marriage ever mean anything to you?

value.name: Marylin offers blackmail bargain
value.description: Marylin tells Miles she will ignore his forgery charge if he drops it and stops pursuing her clients.
evidence: MARYLIN Drop the bogus forgery charge and I'll forget about your generous friends slash clients.

value.name: Miles accuses Marylin of blackmail
value.description: Miles calls Marylin's offer blackmail, and she coolly reframes it as marriage.

value.name: Marylin leaves affectionately
value.description: Marylin kisses Miles on the cheek as she departs and calls him her favorite husband.
evidence: She gives him a peck on the cheek. As she leaves: MARYLIN You'll always be my favorite husband.

value.name: Miles sinks into dejection
value.description: After Marylin leaves, Miles sits alone on the new sofa and stares at the paintings, watch, cigars, and his mother's picture.
evidence: Miles sits dejectedly on the new sofa looking at the paintings. He looks at the watch. And the cigars. And the picture of his mother.

value.name: Miles mourns his absent mother
value.description: Miles speaks to his dead or absent mother, saying she would have enjoyed the situation.
evidence: MILES Pity you can't be here. You'd enjoy this.
